annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC TS 8200:2024 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Controllability of automated artificial intelligence systems
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC TS 8200:2024 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Controllability of automated artificial intelligence systems
annotation.summary_en: ISO/IEC TS 8200:2024 is a technical specification from ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42 setting a framework of principles, characteristics and approaches for the controllability of automated AI systems, covering control transfer, uncertainty handling, and verification and validation. This is a catalogue page showing metadata only.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies a basic framework for realizing and enhancing controllability of automated AI systems
Covers state observability and state transition
Covers control transfer process and cost
Addresses reaction to uncertainty during control transfer
Defines verification and validation approaches; applies to all organization types across the life cycle
